tasks.title: Run Existing Tests to Establish Baseline
tasks.description: Execute all existing tests to understand the current state of the project and establish a baseline for future changes.
success_criteria: All existing tests have been executed
Test results have been documented
Any failing tests have been identified
Baseline test coverage has been measured

tasks.description: Audit and verify the implementation status of core services to identify any placeholder or incomplete implementations.

Placeholder implementations have been identified

Service health status has been documented

success_criteria: Database can be initialized without errors
Real data (900+ items) can be imported

Database views work correctly

Health endpoint returns 200 OK
OpenAPI documentation is accessible

success_criteria: All task statuses normalized to todo/doing/blocked/done/failed
